name: Activity Feed
description: A workspace activity timeline grouped by day, filtered by type and person, with word-level diffs, before-and-after values and status moves shown inline.

props.name: events
props.type: { id; day; date?; time; actorId; type: "edit" | "comment" | "status" | "member"; action; target; change? }[]
props.description: Newest first. Consecutive events with the same `day` share a heading. `change` is a word-level text diff, a before/after value, a status move, or a quote.

props.name: people
props.description: Actors, and the avatar filter in the header.

props.name: showDiffs
props.description: Show the inline changes under each event.

props.name: filter
props.description: Optional. Drive the type filter from outside; pair with onFilterChange.

props.name: onFilterChange
props.description: Called when a type chip is chosen.

props.name: person
props.description: Optional. Drive the person filter from outside; pair with onPersonChange.

props.name: onPersonChange
props.description: Called when an avatar is toggled.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one accent: the active chip’s count and the selected person’s ring. Diff colours are semantic (added, removed).
